movieNights.title: Movie Nights
movieNights.short: Watch something good, meet people, and spend an evening together.
movieNights.description: Movie Nights are relaxed community evenings built around films, conversation and good company. Add photos from each night to the movie-nights folder and they will appear here automatically.

photographyCompetition.title: Photography Competition
photographyCompetition.short: Capture Varanasi through your own lens.
photographyCompetition.description: A community photography competition where everyone gets a chance to show Varanasi from their own perspective.
rules: The photograph must be your own original work.
The theme is Varanasi. Interpret the city in your own way.
Do not use AI tools to generate or materially alter the photograph.
Basic colour, exposure, crop and similar photographic adjustments are allowed.
Please submit the highest-quality version you have available.
photographyCompetition.submissionNote: Use the submission button to send your entry through the community submission form.
